text:
Predicates:
British(x) ::: x is British.
Starring(x, y) ::: x is a series starring y.
Member(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
Piloted(x, y, z) ::: x piloted in month y of year z.
WorkingTitle(x, y, z) ::: x has a working title y used for z.
ScriptEditor(x, y) ::: x is the script editor for y.
Premises:
British(badults) ∧ Starring(badults, pappys) ::: Badults is a British Sitcom series, starring members of Pappy's.
Piloted(badults, july, 2013) ::: Badults piloted in July 2013 on BBC Three.
WorkingTitle(badults, secretDudeSociety, badults) ::: The Working title "The Secret Dude Society" was used for Badults.
ScriptEditor(andrewCollins, badults) ::: Andrew Collins was the script editor for Badults.
Conclusion:
ScriptEditor(andrewCollins, series) ∧ WorkingTitle(series, secretDudeSociety, series) ::: Andrew Collins was the script editor for a series with the working title "The Secret Dude Society".
